name: EmployerOnboardingStateMachine
sourceOfTruth: Django Backend Database (accounts_user.is_onboarded, accounts_user.onboarding_step, profiles_company, profiles_companymember, profiles_companyverification)

NOT_REGISTERED.description: User has not registered an account

AUTHENTICATED_NOT_ONBOARDED.description: User is active, authenticated, but is_onboarded=False

DRAFT_STEP_1_SAVED.description: Company profile details saved via PATCH /api/v1/auth/onboarding/employer/step/ (onboarding_step=1)

ONBOARDED_KYC_PENDING.description: Onboarding completed with GPKD upload. User is_onboarded=True, CompanyVerification.status=PENDING

ONBOARDED_ACTIVE.description: Onboarding completed without GPKD or after verification approval. User is_onboarded=True
